request.objective: Start at https://new.mta.info/. Find the list of neighborhood maps for Brooklyn on new.mta.info.

result.excerpt:
Starting at https://new.mta.info/ takes you straight to https://www.mta.info/ — the MTA home page — since the "new." address now just forwards there. From the home page the route is Maps → Neighborhood maps → Brooklyn, which opens **https://www.mta.info/maps/neighborhood-maps/brooklyn**, headed "Brooklyn neighborhood maps".

That page lists **168 Brooklyn neighborhood maps**, one per station area, each linking out to its own map document. The complete list:
